name: model_op_rotary_embedding
description: SGLang fused RoPE applied in place to query and key (sgl_kernel.apply_rope_with_cos_sin_cache_inplace). positions [nnz] int64, query [nnz, num_q_heads*head_size], key [nnz, num_kv_heads*head_size] float16/bfloat16, cos_sin_cache [max_position, rotary_dim] float32 with cos in the first half and sin in the second half of the last dim. rotary_dim is inferred from cos_sin_cache.shape[-1]; dimensions past rotary_dim are passed through unrotated. is_neox=True rotates the two halves of each head ([..., :d/2] against [..., d/2:]); is_neox=False rotates the interleaved even/odd lanes. Rotation is computed in float32 and written back into query and key in their original dtype. Returns None.
